records.text: Granite Analytics churned, flagging for the pipeline review

records.subject: Confirming cancellation for Granite Analytics
records.body:
Hi Isla,

Confirming the cancellation on our end. We're sorry Wrenfield didn't end up being the right fit for Granite Analytics -- the door's open if that changes.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.subject: Checking in on Granite Analytics' setup
records.body:
Hi Isla,

Saw you got your first project set up -- how's it feeling so far?

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.subject: A better way to track team projects
records.body:
Hi Isla,

Looking to get more out of Wrenfield? Inviting your teammates is the single biggest thing that makes it click.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: You're in -- let's get Granite Analytics set up
records.body:
Hi Isla,

Thanks for trying Wrenfield. A quick tip: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them -- so the first few minutes are usually spent creating one project and adding a few tasks to it.

Let us know how it goes.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: First project reached day 1 (fast start) and welcome call held [calendar:d189d8de], but no reply to any outreach [email:653d58fb, email:a6d14b52], no invite sent, and no key milestone in 6 days with 8 left. Silence after a held call suggests drift, though Pro plan and early project signal some intent.

draft.subject: Next step for Granite Analytics
draft.body:
Hi Isla,

Thanks again for the welcome call last week — good to hear how you're thinking about Granite Analytics' projects.

Since you've got your first project in place, the usual next step is bringing a teammate in: a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time if you'd rather do several at once.

Would a short call this week help? Happy to walk through the next step with you and answer anything that's come up.

Best,
Chidi
